description: Domain checklist catalog consumed by build_review_plan.py. Each entry seeds one Deep Review domain task: a starting-point checklist (derived from skills/kicad/references/deep-review.md comparison heuristics and skills/kicad/references/report-generation.md domain focus areas), the analyzer artifacts the pass should read, and a suggested finding-category prefix. Checklists are starting points, not ceilings -- the methodology reference governs when the two disagree.

domains.title: RF / Wireless Front-End
checklist: Trace the RF chain through switches, LNAs, mixers, filters, and PAs; confirm each stage's pin functions match the traced topology.
Verify matching network component values against the transceiver/module's app-circuit for the actual board antenna and target frequency/impedance (50 ohm unless documented otherwise).
Check decoupling tiering (bulk + bypass + HF) on every RF supply pin against the datasheet.
Confirm the reference clock/oscillator source, accuracy, and distribution to the RF IC.
Verify ground plane continuity and RF return path under the chain; flag splits or vias crossing the RF trace.
Check antenna keepout: a DRC-enforced keepout zone, not just currently-absent copper (a future zone refill could add copper silently).
Cross-check the analyzer's RF chain / RF matching network findings against the raw schematic before trusting them.

domains.title: Ethernet / Wired Networking
checklist: Trace the PHY-to-magnetics-to-connector path (the analyzer's BFS tracing) and confirm differential pair polarity/pairing is correct.
Verify differential pair length-match delta against the protocol's tolerance (100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T) -- compute the delta and cite the spec, not just the raw lengths.
Check magnetics (integrated or discrete) center-tap bias resistor/capacitor values against the PHY datasheet.
Confirm Bob Smith termination / common-mode choke presence on unshielded connectors.
Check the PHY supply decoupling and reference (RBIAS) resistor value against the datasheet.
Verify MDI/MDI-X handling (auto-MDIX vs fixed) matches the intended use.
Check chassis-ground vs signal-ground isolation at the connector (ESD/surge path).

domains.title: Cellular / Wi-Fi / BLE / LoRa Modem & Module
checklist: Verify module supply rail voltage and peak TX-burst current against the datasheet; check for adequate bulk capacitance and its placement.
Confirm the antenna matching/pi-network values against the module's app note for the board's actual antenna, not the module's reference antenna.
Check UART/USB/SPI host-interface voltage levels and handshake lines against the host MCU's supply domain.
Verify the SIM/eSIM interface (if present): supply, reset, clock, and ESD protection.
Check RF trace length, ground continuity, and keepout around the module and antenna per the module's layout guide.
Confirm enable/reset/wake sequencing timing against the module's power-up/power-down state machine.

domains.title: MCU Core & Memory Interfaces
checklist: Verify per-domain decoupling (core, I/O, analog) against the datasheet's placement/value requirements.
Check crystal load-cap math (CL = (C1xC2)/(C1+C2) + Cstray) against the crystal's spec and the MCU's drive level.
Verify boot-strap pull direction against the intended boot source and the datasheet's boot-pin table.
Check the reset circuit (RC / supervisor) against the MCU's reset threshold and timing spec.
For external flash/QSPI/eMMC/DRAM: verify supply sequencing relative to the MCU, bus voltage-level compatibility, and series/termination resistors against the datasheet.
Confirm the debug interface (SWD/JTAG) pull resistors and voltage domain match the MCU and the debug probe.
Check 5V-tolerance: any MCU pin fed from a higher-voltage domain than its own supply.

domains.title: Power Tree & Regulation
checklist: Recompute each regulator's Vout from the FB divider and the datasheet Vref (not the analyzer's heuristic) and compare against the rail name and downstream requirement.
Verify Vin range (worst case, not nominal -- include supply tolerance and transients) against the regulator's absolute max and recommended operating range.
Check required externals (inductance floor, input/output caps with DC-bias derating, bootstrap/feed-forward caps) against datasheet minimums.
Verify enable/power-good pull-up voltage domains and sequencing (core-before-IO, PG chaining) against the full power tree.
Sum worst-case load per shared rail against the regulator's rated current, including inrush.
Check thermal: Pdiss = (Vin-Vout)xIout (linears) or efficiency-derived (switchers) against Rth_JA x Pdiss + Tambient vs Tj_max.

domains.title: General I/O & Sensors
checklist: Verify floating digital inputs have a defined pull-up/pull-down or are explicitly marked no-connect.
Check the ADC/DAC reference voltage chain and anti-aliasing filter against the signal's expected frequency/amplitude.
Verify sensor interrupt lines, bus clustering, and address/CS assignment don't conflict.
Check LED/relay/opto driver current limiting and flyback/snubber protection against the datasheet.
Verify connector current-per-pin against the actual load (cross-reference cross_analysis.json CC-001).
Check ESD protection coverage on user-facing/external I/O pins.

domains.title: Communication Interfaces & Buses
checklist: For each bus (I2C/SPI/UART/CAN/RS-485/USB/HDMI/display-touch): verify both ends' logic thresholds against the shared rail (VIH of the reader vs VOH of the driver) and pull-up ownership/value (watch for parallel pull-ups on a shared net).
Check bus speed against the slowest device's rating and trace length/termination requirements.
Verify level shifters (IC-based or discrete) map correctly to each side's supply domain.
Check USB compliance: series resistors, pull-ups for the declared speed, VBUS tolerance of PHY pins.
Verify isolation barriers (if present) maintain creepage/clearance and don't bridge grounds.
Check display/touch controller interface timing and supply sequencing against its datasheet.

domains.title: Board-Level EMC & Layout
checklist: Review analyze_emc.py findings (ground plane integrity, decoupling, switching harmonics, PDN impedance, diff-pair skew, ESD paths) and triage each against the raw layout -- the analyzer is a starting point, not the final word.
Check ground plane continuity under high-dv/dt and high-frequency traces; flag splits or return-path discontinuities.
Verify switching regulator loop area and the proximity of input/output caps to the IC.
Check stitching-via density around layer transitions and board edges.
Verify filter component placement (ferrites, common-mode chokes) relative to the noise source and the protected domain.
Check connector/cable shield grounding and chassis-vs-signal ground separation.
